issue.title: CI parity: SHA-pin all GitHub Actions and add the enforcement gate
issue.body:
# CI parity: SHA-pin all GitHub Actions and add the enforcement gate

## Summary

fluent-mobile is the last repo in the org still running GitHub Actions on mutable tags:
**21 of its 22 action references are unpinned.** fluent-api, fluent-web and fluent-ai were
brought to a SHA-pinned baseline with a mechanical CI gate; this ticket brings mobile to the
same standard.

## Why this matters here more than elsewhere

A tag is a moving pointer. Whoever controls the action can re-point `@v7` at a new commit and
the next workflow run picks it up with no review. That risk is not evenly distributed, and
mobile's workflows are the ones holding release credentials:

- `expo/expo-github-action@v9` (×2) runs in `preview-build.yml` and `nightly-preview.yml`
  with an Expo token — it can publish builds.
- `actions/github-script@v9` (×3) runs with the repo token in `qa-handoff.yml`,
  `preview-build.yml` and `nightly-preview.yml`.

This is also the repo that proves convention alone does not hold. The other three were pinned
by hand and stayed pinned; mobile drifted to 21 unpinned refs with nobody noticing, because a
hand-written `@v7` reads as perfectly normal in review. That is the argument for the gate, not
just the pinning.

## Current state

| | fluent-api | fluent-web | fluent-ai | **fluent-mobile** |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Actions SHA-pinned | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | **1 of 22** |
| `Action pins` CI gate | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | **none** |
| `Action pins` required check | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | **n/a** |
| Dependabot grouping | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | **none** |
| Dependabot cooldown | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | **none** |
| Label convention | `github_actions` | `github_actions` | `github_actions` | **`github-actions`** |

## Scope

### 1. Pin all action references

21 unpinned refs across 7 workflows. All resolved against upstream; **no version changes** —
each SHA is what the tag points at today:

| Action | Count | Pin to | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actions/checkout` | 9 | `3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1` | `# v7.0.1` |
| `actions/setup-node` | 7 | `820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020` | `# v7.0.0` |
| `actions/github-script` | 3 | `3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3` | `# v9.0.0` |
| `expo/expo-github-action` | 2 | `eab7a230208c952974db8c3245cfd78402c7b385` | `# v9` |

Files: `lint.yml`, `test.yml`, `quality-gates.yml`, `preview-build.yml`, `nightly-preview.yml`,
`pr-description.yml`, `qa-handoff.yml`.

**Also fix the one existing pin.** `eas-build.yml` pins checkout to
`9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0` (`v7.0.0`) while the rest of the org is on
`v7.0.1`. Bring it in line so all four repos reference the same commit.

Note: `expo/expo-github-action` publishes only floating major tags (`v4`…`v9`) with no point
releases, so the comment stays `# v9` — same situation as `Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1` in
fluent-web. Re-resolve the SHA at implementation time; these were captured on 2026-08-27.

### 2. Add the enforcement gate

Port `.github/workflows/action-pins.yml` and `.github/scripts/check-action-pins.rb` from
fluent-ai (or api/web — all three are identical). Drops in unchanged: mobile has no
`.github/actions/` directory and its jobs already run on `ubuntu-latest`, which ships Ruby.

The checker parses workflow YAML with Psych rather than grepping it, and the gate runs on
`pull_request_target` so neither the workflow definition nor the checker can be modified by the
pull request being judged. **Read the header comment in `action-pins.yml` before touching that
file** — the safety of `pull_request_target` here depends on the job never executing
pull-request code.

### 3. Dependabot parity

`.github/dependabot.yml`, `github-actions` ecosystem only — leave the npm block alone:

- Add a `groups` block with `patterns: ['*']` so action bumps land in one PR rather than one
  per action. Use a wildcard, not an enumerated vendor list: an enumerated list drops any
  vendor nobody remembers to add, and here it would need to cover `expo/*`.
- Add a second group with `applies-to: security-updates` and the same wildcard — without it,
  action security advisories still open one PR each.
- Add `cooldown: { default-days: 7 }`, matching the other three.
- Rename the label to `github_actions` (see below).

### 4. Label rename

Repo uses `github-actions` (hyphen); the org standardized on `github_actions`. Rename the label
**and** update the `labels:` list in `.github/dependabot.yml` — Dependabot cannot apply a label
that does not exist, and it fails silently. fluent-ai hit exactly this: the config kept
requesting a renamed label and grouped PRs quietly lost it, which is also why org-wide
`--label github_actions` queries skipped that repo entirely.

### 5. Branch protection

Add `Action pins` to the required status checks on `main`, **alongside** the existing
`PR Description` check — do not replace it. Use the
`branches/main/protection/required_status_checks` endpoint rather than a full protection `PUT`,
so the existing `strict: true`, 1 review, and code-owner-review settings are untouched.

## Out of scope

- Any action **version** bump. This is pinning only; Dependabot handles versions afterwards.
- The `excessive-permissions` work (missing `permissions:` blocks). Mobile has the same gap as
  the other repos, but that is a separate, larger piece of work and is on hold org-wide.
- Adopting zizmor as a blocking check. Worth revisiting once permissions work lands; today it
  reports enough pre-existing findings that a blanket gate would be red on day one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `ruby .github/scripts/check-action-pins.rb` exits 0 against `main`.
- [ ] All 22 references (21 newly pinned + the corrected `eas-build.yml` pin) are 40-character
      SHAs with an accurate version comment.
- [ ] No action version changed — each SHA resolves to the tag it replaced.
- [ ] `action-pins.yml` present and passing on a real PR.
- [ ] Gate proven to **fail**: push an unpinned ref on a scratch branch, confirm the check goes
      red and the PR reports `mergeable_state=blocked`, then revert.
- [ ] `Action pins` required on `main`; `PR Description` still required.
- [ ] Dependabot config has both groups, cooldown, and the corrected label.
- [ ] Label `github_actions` exists and `github-actions` is gone.

## Implementation notes

**The gate cannot pass on its own PR.** Because `pull_request_target` takes the workflow
definition from the base branch, `action-pins.yml` will not run on the PR that introduces it —
it takes effect on the first PR opened afterwards. This is expected; verify the checker locally
instead. Do not "fix" it by switching to `pull_request`, which reopens the bypass the design
exists to close.

**Sequence matters.** Land the pinning first, then the gate, then the required check. Enabling
the required check before the workflow exists blocks every PR on a status that can never report.

**7 open PRs will be blocked** the moment `Action pins` becomes required, since none of them has
produced that check yet. It appears on each PR's next push. `strict: true` is already set, so
those branches need an update before merging regardless — but warn the team rather than
surprising them.

**Prior art, including the mistakes.** These were worked out across three repos and several
review rounds; the reasoning is in the PRs rather than rediscoverable from the final diff:

- fluent-api #285, #287 — pinning, then the gate and Dependabot grouping
- fluent-web #438, #440 — same, plus the YAML-alias bypass
- fluent-ai #64, #66 — exact version comments, plus `docs/guides/dependabot-workflow.md`

Two findings worth knowing before writing any variant of the checker: a line-based grep gets
four cases wrong (quoted refs, quoted local refs, `uses:` inside `run: |` blocks, and
flow-style steps), and an early YAML version silently skipped `uses: *alias`, reporting
"All 0 action reference(s) ... are pinned" on a file containing an unpinned action. The current
checker handles both; porting it unmodified is strongly preferred over rewriting it.
